_readme: One badge per phase. Unlocked by bin/done.sh when the phase's check passes. XP: 100 per lesson passed, +50 for a perfect quiz. Titles by XP in levels.

00.unlock: Your first session, logged. Claude knows your name now.

01.unlock: Claude reads your CLAUDE.md before you type a word.

02.unlock: Every number you show has a source someone can reopen.

03.unlock: Files in, report out, even with no terminal open (headless).

04.unlock: Your weekly recap is now one slash command.

05.unlock: The harness nags for you. You never forget a deadline again.

06.unlock: You have a read-only analyst that works while you sleep.

07.unlock: A real KR, read live from a real source, with as-of date.

08.unlock: Memory, cadences, plugins: your OS survives the week.

09.unlock: You run your channel on your own Growth OS. Certificate time.
